description: Step 3a acceptance expectations (docs/step3a_contract.md, 验收). Every item was checked against the source text on 2026-11-03: FDA labels from openFDA (set id, version, effective date below), GeneReviews from the local NCBI Literature Archive copy. Used by scripts/acceptance_step3a.py; the viewer only displays its result. match: case-insensitive regex on the action label or key; branch: regex on the branch disease label (omitted = every branch the action applies to); expect.status: applicable / conditional / not_applicable, or 'present' = the action is in that section with any status; expect.unknown: regexes, each must match a requirement whose result is unknown.
